description: Defines data structures and constants related to NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) satellite ephemeris, timing, and configuration within the ocudu namespace, including satellite position, orbital parameters, NTN assistance info, and neighbor cell configuration.

classes.name: ntn_polarization_t
classes.description: Contains optional polarization information for downlink and uplink on NTN service links.

classes.name: ntn_config
classes.description: Holds various configuration parameters for NTN operation, including timing, satellite ephemeris, and polarization.

classes.name: ntn_cov_enh_t
classes.description: Parameters to enhance NTN coverage, such as repetition slots and RSRP thresholds.

classes.name: sat_switch_with_resync_t
classes.description: Parameters for satellite switching with resynchronization, including NTN config, timing, and satellite position.

classes.name: neighbor_ntn_cell
classes.description: Configuration for neighboring NTN cells, including frequency and cell ID.
